beats.text: One question on your first date tells you how the night ends.
Ask: do you like the taste of beer?
Beer fans were sixty percent more likely to be okay with a hookup on night one. Men and women!
For something long-term, ask three things: horror movies, solo travel abroad, life on a sailboat.
Long-term couples agreed on all three almost four times more often than chance. Because

sources: OkCupid (2011), 'The Best Questions For A First Date' (OkTrends). Liking the taste of beer: 60% more likely to be okay with sex with someone just met (both genders); horror movies / travel alone abroad / sailboat: 32% of long-term couples agreed on all three, 3.7x coincidence.
